name: Slate
title: Dealer in Sundries
examine: A gray, agreeable man with a corner stall and no history he will admit to. Answers most questions with prices. Slate is what was left after he dropped the other name on the road.
lines: Rope, tallow, keys. Other things by asking. Asking costs.
I buy odd lots. No questions is the house specialty.
Everything on this crate has a price. Most things off it, too.
